author: Nancy Burns-Fusaro
title: Third annual 'United Holiday Spectacular' to take place Sunday | Entertainment | thewesterlysun.com
text:
WESTERLY — The third annual "United Holiday Spectacular" — a one-hour production inspired by Radio City’s Christmas Spectacular that features more than 60 young, local performers ready to dance, play and sing festive holiday favorites— is set to take place this Sunday, keeping a new holiday tradition alive.
Third annual 'United Holiday Spectacular' to take place Sunday
Nancy Burns-Fusaro
